description: Ownership manifest for the single-source skill layer. Skills listed in generated_skills are authored once in skills-src/<skill>/SKILL.src.md (plus optional verbatim support files under skills-src/<skill>/files/ for both providers and skills-src/<skill>/files-claude/ or skills-src/<skill>/files-codex/ for one) and regenerated into both provider packages by scripts/Build-ProviderSkillPackages.ps1. Every skill not listed in generated_skills is provider-owned; the generator must not touch it.
notes: Generated skills are parity-enforced by construction: scripts/Build-ProviderSkillPackages.ps1 -Check byte-verifies both provider copies against the canon, so any per-provider difference must be an explicit conditional block or token in SKILL.src.md. provider_owned_shared_skills are pairs that ship in both packages but are still authored per provider; each needs an entry in declared_provider_forks stating why, and scripts/Compare-ProviderSkillParity.ps1 -FailOnUndeclaredFork fails the release gate on any undeclared fork.

declared_provider_forks.telemetry-live-ops: Machine-local ops skill and a declared whole-document fork: the Claude and Codex presentations are intentionally different documents, not one workflow contract. Revisit only if the pair is ever reconciled.
